allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: UMIYA BUILDCON LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding 'This is to inform that the Chairman & Managing Director of Umiya Buildcon Limited presented his update to the Board of Directors at the Board Meeting held on October 15, 2025.The address highlighted the Company s performance during the last quarter and half-year, and included key updates on the final allotment of land by the Government of Karnataka and MRO-TEK Cornus Family 1G Switches.An extract of the Chairman & Managing Director s address, as presented to the Board, is enclosed herewith for your information and records'.
